_comment: Crosswalk Zetaris objects in onboarding order; each create script has a _select.sql verification pair. Status is from the Day-0 gate runs against Zetaris Lightning 2.4.3.1 (local Docker) on 2026-10-25; counts and timings in README.md. The user-agent placeholder in REST scripts is replaced from CW_USER_AGENT at run time. sql/won-reference/ is the sister entry's SQL, reference only, never run here.

sources.summary: OpenFEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries v2 filtered to major disasters (DR) declared in Q1 2025 (116 designated areas, 10 declarations, 8 states; equals the response fetched outside Zetaris) and the OpenFemaDataSets v1 catalogue (44 rows, 43 distinct names); container cw created here; both views cached (2026-10-25). CY2024Q1 registered at run time through the gateway's register_source (catalogue id openfema_disaster_declarations -> register_fema, signed contract): 72 designated areas, 14 declarations, 11 states, equal to the same URL fetched outside Zetaris; cached; registration 1.34 s wall (2026-10-25)

NOAA GHCN-Daily station inventory ghcnd-stations.txt as a one-column CSV (delimiter '|', never in the file) parsed with SUBSTR into id, state, name, latitude, longitude; 133,039 rows (= the file's line count), 78,568 US stations with a state, the 56 seed stations present with 56/56 states equal to seeds/stations.json; view cached (2026-10-25)

SEC EDGAR XBRL frames for Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax and RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue x CY2025Q1, CY2024Q1 (1,937 / 2,095 / 2,546 / 2,654 / 20 / 22 facts, equal to the sister entry's source counts) and the submissions profile of the 43 seed utilities; 148 statements in 68 s; every view cached (2026-10-25)
company_dns SIC reference V4, 1,005 codes (1,005 distinct, all four digits), raw table and view cw.sic_codes cached (2026-10-25)

The committed seed files as SchemaStore views over inline VALUES: cw.states (51), cw.utility_states (97 pairs, 43 utilities, 43 states, 0 orphans against cw.states), cw.seed_stations (56), and cw.seed_utilities (43 rows from the 43 cached submission views with the seed ticker: 40 with a ticker; SIC 4911 x 25, 4931 x 16, 4932 x 1, 4900 x 1 = MGE Energy); all cached (2026-10-25)

The five join keys measured over cached views (match rate = matched distinct left keys / distinct left keys): (a) cik lpad10 43/42 = 0.977 VERIFIED (orphan IDACORP, no CY2025Q1 fact); (b) loc substr(4,2) vs business state 42/42 = 1.0; (c) FEMA state vs served states 8/7 = 0.875 PARTIAL (orphan AK), FEMA FIPS vs state reference 8/8; (d) seed station id vs inventory 56/56 with 56/56 states equal; (e) SIC vs sic_codes 4/3 = 0.75 by distinct codes, 43/42 = 0.977 by utility (orphan MGE Energy 4900). Every statement under 19 s (2026-10-25)

USL crosswalk_usl in lightning.metastore.crosswalk: state, sic_code, utility, utility_state, fema_declaration, station, revenue_quarter with PK/FK and descriptions, each activated from a cached view (51 / 1,005 / 43 / 97 / 116 / 56 / 133 rows); RUN DQ per FK: utility.sic 43 / 42 / 1 (MGE Energy, SIC 4900 absent from company_dns), utility_state.cik 97 / 97 / 0, utility_state.state 97 / 97 / 0, fema_declaration.state 116 / 116 / 0, station.state 56 / 56 / 0, revenue_quarter.cik 133 / 133 / 0 on a second run after one refused SEC connection (2026-10-25); weather_quarter not in the model (no GHCN parquet registered on Day 0)

dq: primary and foreign key rules named after their columns (LIST DQ USL)

sources.summary: cw.seed_utility_names: cik (10-digit string), name, ticker, sic of the 43 seed utilities as a VALUES view generated from seeds/utilities.json by scripts/make_cw_sql.py; 43 rows, 43 CIKs, 40 tickers, 4 SIC codes, read in 0.24 s; cached. The answer path reads names here, never cw.seed_utilities (17 s per read) (2026-10-25)

NOAA GHCN-Daily parquet by_year 2024 and 2025 x TMAX, TMIN as CW_GHCN filestore tables, registered through the gateway's register_source (catalogue id noaa_ghcn_by_year -> register_ghcn, one signed contract each, 54-58 s wall each, CACHE 41-45 s), with station-filtered views over the 56 seed stations plus the validation station USW00013740; 20,801 / 20,799 / 20,859 / 20,858 rows, 57 stations each, full-year date ranges; degree days for USW00013740 and USW00013722 in Q1 2025 and Q1 2024 equal the sister entry's pyarrow values to 0.01; every view cached (2026-10-25)
